name: Why You Should or Should Not Go to Vampire Bars and Try to Kiss Strangers
source:
In this city, humans and vampires coexist, more or less. Some places are mixed company, others are off-limits. Don't go where you weren't invited, and you'll be safe — simple words to live by. But who said being safe is fun? Dying of curiosity, you, a human, decide to go to a vampire bar undercover and make new friends, or even kiss a stranger or two. Let’s see how well that goes for you. 

[From [url=https://elolaps.itch.io/vampire-bar]itch.io[/url]]
